headline: Full identity unblock: provider-journey verifier shipped (22/22 self-tests, build:check 275/275), Obelisk W242 review delivered, promotion sequence armed. Scheduled agent filed and drove sitemap SEO fix (PR #76) to compliance-green.

items.title: Provider-journey verifier shipped — 22/22 self-tests, 5 live legs observed
items.insight: scripts/verify-provider-journey.mjs is the only supported writer of the five providerJourney evidence legs; privacy guard refuses identifier-shaped output; receipt rebuilt and re-read after the write.

items.title: Obelisk W242 (revoke + logout) delivered to Obelisk via Ark
items.insight: W240 draft upgraded to W242 (throttling, macaroon session revocation, no-store headers, exact post-logout matching); review requested via Ark agent-handoff 01JV4VS3OB4DE3B70E6F2B17FC. Live probe still: /auth/revoke 400 (old catch-all), /auth/logout 404.

items.title: Missing journal article added to sitemap; coverage checker extended to journal/
items.insight: Scheduled agent identified /journal/building-vault-membership/ was absent from sitemap.xml despite full OG/JSON-LD markup. Coverage checker now auto-detects journal article slugs — prevents recurrence.
